summary: Reject Windows credential files with NULL DACLs under combined security-control flags.
reason: Checking only the start of the SDDL flag prefix could mistake a world-accessible NULL DACL for an empty restrictive ACL. The native descriptor must also reject an absent DACL.
validated_outcome: Synthetic ACL tests cover combined control flags. macOS tests and Windows amd64/arm64 cross-builds pass; native Windows execution is unverified.
safety: Credential files with ambiguous or absent access controls are rejected rather than accepted.
